objectives: Describe the birth of Isaac and the feast of his weaning.
Explain why Hagar and Ishmael were sent away.
takeaways: The Lord visited Sarah at the set time; Isaac means he will laugh, and he was circumcised at eight days.
The feast was for Isaac's weaning at about three years old, not a birthday (2 Maccabees 7:27).
In Isaac shall thy seed be called: Sarah was on point, and the son of the bondwoman would not be heir.
Ishmael could not die in the wilderness; the prophecy of a great nation stood over him.
Beersheba means the well of the oath, where Abraham and Abimelech made a covenant.
